name: Glyptodonts
description: Glyptodonts are extinct armoured herbivore Mammals, close relatives of modern armadillos. $(br2)Most carried a rigid, domed shell of fused bony plates, along with an armoured cap on the head and a protected tail. This group also includes the pampatheres, whose shells had movable bands like an armadillo's. $(br2)They lived in the grasslands and woodlands of the Americas.
